open_points.subject: StoreRepository interface
open_points.text: Every read and write of a row goes through one typed record port, `StoreRepository`: an interface whose operations are the typed row operations of the closed record types ... Its one implementation is `SqliteStoreRepository`, owned by `store_persistence`.
open_points.question: Which module owns and declares the `StoreRepository` interface itself, so its implementation does not violate the rule that `store_persistence` may know only `models`?
options: `store_persistence` owns and exports both the interface and its implementation
`store` owns the interface and `store_persistence` satisfies it structurally without importing `store`
a separate lower-level module owns the interface
open_points.default_guess: `store_persistence` owns and exports the interface alongside `SqliteStoreRepository`.

open_points.subject: Pinned dependency and sandbox-runtime versions
open_points.text: The pinned Python dependencies and sandbox runtime of A20 rule 3 are a release artifact built and checked outside the running kernel; at run time only `sandbox.probe_sandbox` checks that a sandbox works.
open_points.question: What module or named build component owns selecting, recording and verifying the exact dependency and sandbox-runtime versions required by A20?
options: a named release-build or packaging component outside the runtime modules
`sandbox` for its runtime and the package configuration for kernel dependencies
open_points.default_guess: A named release-build or packaging component owns the pins and their verification, while `data_provider` owns only runtime constants.
